propositions: The planning corpus count assertion (PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE = 113) drifts when historical tickets are reclassified to/from bug or when new tickets change short-prefix resolution, because corpus membership is re-derived at runtime from live ticket state rather than pinned by commit identity.
The corpus was described as 'pinned and reproducible' but the size-based assertion is a moving target vulnerable to tracker churn; identity pinning by SHA is immune to reclassification.
The check mode must replace the count assertion with a frozenset of the exact 113 commit SHAs that were adjudicated, then measure and validate that set directly against live tracker state.
No CI or test suite invokes the backtest script, so the corpus-size drift (113 → 114) went undetected until manual repro on a pristine detached worktree.
